verdict.rationale: The evidence describes LocalAI as "one binary" with an OpenAI-compatible API, but nothing documents startup or cold-start latency, binary footprint, or time-to-first-inference. Model preloading (PRELOAD_MODELS) is a related startup control, not evidence of a fast cold start. Cold-start performance is a fair question for a local inference runtime, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can get a fast cold start from a lightweight runtime binary instead of waiting seconds before inference begins
